core_obligations: Summand argument: choose a K-flat resolution N^* of the left dual with flat terms and write eta(1) = Sigma f_i  otimes  g_i after shrinking; for any subcomplex K^*  subset  M^* containing the f_i, eta factors through Tot(K^*  otimes  N^*) (flatness of the N^n), and the commutative diagram with (1  otimes  epsilon) makes M a direct summand of K in D(O_X) (proof lines 13073-13111).

Boundedness: first take K^* = sigma_{>=a}tau_{<=b}M^* to make M a summand of a bounded complex; then a bounded above flat resolution lets K^* = sigma_{>=a}M^* make M a summand of a bounded complex of flat modules, so M has finite tor amplitude (proof lines 13112-13133).

Pseudo-coherence descent setup: for the presentation E^* -> M with cohomology isos in degrees > m and surjection in degree m, represent L by the explicit complex L^* concentrated in degrees < m; apply the summand argument to this complex to get finitely many sections f_i of M^{n_i}; define K^n  subset  L^n generated by the f_i for n_i = n and d(f_i) for n_i = n-1, and K^n = E^n for n >= m, giving a morphism of distinguished triangles (E^*, M^*, L^*) -> (E^*, K^*, sigma_{<=m-1}K^*) (proof lines 13134-13173).

The summand argument gives s : M -> K with K -> M composing to the identity; by the local-actual lemma assume s o i is given by a map of complexes sigma : E^* -> K^* homotopic to zero after composing with the inclusion; enlarge K^{m-1} by Im(h^m) (still finitely generated) to make sigma itself null-homotopic (proof lines 13174-13225).

The triangulated-category axioms give the dotted arrow in the 3x3 triangle diagram; the induced diagram on H^{m-1} shows the middle composition is surjective, and a diagram chase in the long exact sequences gives H^i(K) -> H^i(M) an isomorphism for i >= m and a surjection for i = m-1; the composition (O_X^ oplus r -> E^m -> E^{m+1} -> ...) -> K -> M is the desired presentation, completing the induction (proof lines 13226-13281).
proof_roadmap: Run the summand argument: M is a direct summand of a bounded complex of flat modules.
Set up the pseudo-coherence descent with the explicit subcomplex K^*.
Kill the obstruction sigma by homotopy manipulation.
Finish the induction step with the triangulated axiom and a diagram chase.
difficulty_reason: The proof runs the celebrated summand argument three times (boundedness, flat boundedness, pseudo-coherence descent) and then executes the m -> m-1 induction step: explicit subcomplex K^* built from finitely many sections, morphism of triangles, homotopy manipulation via the local-actual lemma making sigma null-homotopic, the triangulated-category axiom arrow, and a diagram chase in degree m-1 giving the presentation of M.
